name: madenci
description: Minimal-code mode for coding agents — the Age of Empires II miner as a skill.

plugins.name: madenci
plugins.description: Dig where the ore is: the smallest complete change — reuse first, stdlib first, no unrequested abstraction or dependency. On by default; reaches subagents. Commands: kalk, yat, lite, full, ultra, debt, audit, help.
